## Column Body Outset Right Test

This tests the `.column-body-outset-right` class which extends content to the right.

::: {.column-body-outset-right}
OUTSET-RIGHT-CONTENT: This content should extend into the right margin while keeping the left edge aligned with the body column.
:::

Regular text for comparison.
